The '''kidnapping of Setenna Hase''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I had my suspicions at Arda I that something was not right. Now I hear you have already found something here that could point to a traitor among us.|[[Urel Haydon]]|<ref name="OAA" />}}
After the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]], which saw the destruction of their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] settled on a [[Resolute Base|new base]] on [[Jagomir]]. A few days after the construction of their base, the Rebels began scouting the area around it and found evidence that a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] was among them. They were subsequently attacked by [[evarrian]]s of a nearby nest but they defeated them and returned to the base with the news.<ref name="OAA" />

==Investigation==
{{Quote|I can't believe that Var would do this. He's been with us for years and helped us in many missions. Why would he turn?|[[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]]|<ref name="OAA" />}}
In order to find the traitor, the Rebels started to question other members of the Alliance on their whereabouts, background and mission knowledge. Some suspects were interrogated including [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dorrian Vodani]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior [[Isshtharr]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Masi Qual]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] pilot [[Rik Torrence]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Urtuaa Haaot]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droid]] [[VX-19]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Var Narek]] was finally exposed as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy and a traitor to the Alliance.<ref name="OAA" />

==Kidnapping==
{{Quote|I am going to have to take my leave now, and if you wish to see Setenna alive again, you will not follow us.|[[Var Narek]]|<ref name="OAA" />}}
Var Narek consecutively held [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]] hostage and fled with his prisoner on a [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]]. The Rebels chased him across the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of Jagomir but he managed to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard a [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]]. Var Narek set course for [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] so that Setenna Hase could be interrogated by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. The Rebels soon went after them on a [[Mission to Ord Radama|mission]] to rescue the valuable Alliance leader.<ref name="OAA" />
